KdVPlan.Yst a τ f a=0
result.proof:
intro a τ f
have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hY : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t = KdVPlan.Cst a f t+KdVPlan.Qst a f t-KdVPlan.scale (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) := by
  intro t; funext k
  simp only [KdVPlan.Yst,KdVPlan.Vst,KdVPlan.z,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply]
  ring
have hzC : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Cst a f t 0=0 := by
 intro t
 simp only [KdVPlan.Cst,KdVPlan.timeInt]
  have hzero : (fun s => KdVPlan.B s f (KdVPlan.F a f s) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext (fun s => hzB s _ _)
  rw [hzero]; simp
have hzQ : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Qst a f t 0=0 := by
 intro t
 simp only [KdVPlan.Qst,KdVPlan.scale,KdVPlan.timeInt]
 have hzero : (fun s => KdVPlan.B s (KdVPlan.F a f s) (KdVPlan.F a f s) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext (fun s => hzB s _ _)
 rw [hzero]; simp
have hzW : KdVPlan.Wst a τ f 0=0 := by
 simp [KdVPlan.Wst,hzQ,KdVPlan.rem,KdVPlan.remWith]
have hzY : ∀ t, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t) := by
 intro t; rw [hY]; change KdVPlan.Cst a f t 0 + KdVPlan.Qst a f t 0 - (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) * KdVPlan.Wst a τ f 0 = 0
 rw [hzC,hzQ,hzW]; ring
refine ⟨hY,hzY,?_,?_⟩
· intro t
  change deriv (fun r => KdVPlan.Yst a τ f r 0) t=0
 have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.Yst a τ f r 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext hzY
  rw [heq]; exact deriv_const _ _
· rw [hY]; funext k
 simp [KdVPlan.Cst,KdVPlan.Qst,KdVPlan.timeInt,KdVPlan.scale]

arguments.proof:
intro a τ f
have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hY : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t = KdVPlan.Cst a f t+KdVPlan.Qst a f t-KdVPlan.scale (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) := by
  intro t; funext k
  simp only [KdVPlan.Yst,KdVPlan.Vst,KdVPlan.z,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply]
  ring
have hzC : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Cst a f t 0=0 := by
  intro t
  simp only [KdVPlan.Cst,KdVPlan.timeInt]
  have hzero : (fun s => KdVPlan.B s f (KdVPlan.F a f s) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext (fun s => hzB s _ _)
  rw [hzero]; simp
have hzQ : ∀ t, KdVPlan.Qst a f t 0=0 := by
  intro t
  simp only [KdVPlan.Qst,KdVPlan.scale,KdVPlan.timeInt]
  have hzero : (fun s => KdVPlan.B s (KdVPlan.F a f s) (KdVPlan.F a f s) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext (fun s => hzB s _ _)
  rw [hzero]; simp
have hzW : KdVPlan.Wst a τ f 0=0 := by
  simp [KdVPlan.Wst,hzQ,KdVPlan.rem,KdVPlan.remWith]
have hzY : ∀ t, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t) := by
  intro t; rw [hY]; change KdVPlan.Cst a f t 0 + KdVPlan.Qst a f t 0 - (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) * KdVPlan.Wst a τ f 0 = 0
  rw [hzC,hzQ,hzW]; ring
refine ⟨hY,hzY,?_,?_⟩
· intro t
  change deriv (fun r => KdVPlan.Yst a τ f r 0) t=0
  have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.Yst a τ f r 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := funext hzY
  rw [heq]; exact deriv_const _ _
· rw [hY]; funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.Cst,KdVPlan.Qst,KdVPlan.timeInt,KdVPlan.scale]

arguments.statement:
∀ (a τ : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff),
0 < τ → KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) →
let D : KdVPlan.Path := fun t => KdVPlan.B t f (KdVPlan.F a f t)+KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t))-KdVPlan.scale ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)
KdVPlan.ContH 0 a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) ∧ KdVPlan.ContH 0 a (a+τ) D ∧
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a (a+τ), ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.Yst a τ f r k) (D t k) t) ∧
∀ t ∈ Ioo a (a+τ), KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) t=D t

intro a τ f hτ hf hzf hW

result.statement: ∀ (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j : ℤ => f j * g (k-j))
result.proof:
intro f g hf hg k
have hf' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hf
have hg' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hg
have he : Function.Injective (fun j : ℤ => k-j) := by
  intro i j h
  change k-i=k-j at h
  omega
have hkg : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g (k-j)‖^2) := hg'.comp_injective he
apply Summable.of_norm
apply ((hf'.add hkg).div_const 2).of_nonneg_of_le
· intro j; positivity
· intro j
  change ‖f j * g (k-j)‖ ≤ (‖f j‖^2+‖g (k-j)‖^2)/2
  rw [norm_mul]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖f j‖-‖g (k-j)‖)]

    simpa [KdVPlan.MemH,KdVPlan.weight,Real.rpow_two] using hf

    have hp0 : Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k=0 then (1:ℝ) else 1/(k:ℝ)^2) := by

constructor
· intro f hf k
  have hs : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH,KdVPlan.weight] using hf
  have hle := hs.le_tsum k (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖f j‖)
  change ‖f k‖ ≤ Real.sqrt _
  simpa [KdVPlan.weight] using (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hle)
· intro f hf
  have hs : Summable (fun k : ℤ => (1+(k:ℝ)^2)^2*‖f k‖^2) := by
    simpa [KdVPlan.MemH,KdVPlan.weight,Real.rpow_two] using hf
  have hp : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2)^2) := by
    have hp0 : Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k=0 then (1:ℝ) else 1/(k:ℝ)^2) := by
      simpa using (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1<2)).ite (fun k => k≠0) (summable_single 0 1)
    apply hp0.of_nonneg_of_le
    · intro k; positivity
    · intro k; by_cases hk : k=0
      · simp [hk]
      · rw [if_neg hk]
        have hk0 : (k:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
        have hpos : 0<(k:ℝ)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hk0
        apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((k:ℝ)^2)]
  apply ((hs.add hp).div_const 2).of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _)
  intro k
  have hpos : 0 < 1+(k:ℝ)^2 := by positivity
  have hsq := sq_nonneg ((1+(k:ℝ)^2)*‖f k‖-1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2))
  have hc : ((1+(k:ℝ)^2)*‖f k‖)*(1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2))=‖f k‖ := by field_simp
  nlinarith [hc]

  0 < gamma ∧ gamma ≤ 1 →
    KdVPlan.RemOutput →
      KdVPlan.BilinearOutput →
        KdVPlan.ContinuousOutput gamma →
          KdVPlan.SobolevInfrastructure → Summable fun k => if k = 0 then 1 else 1 / ↑k ^ 2

helper.name: yui_aux_0053
helper.statement: Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k=0 then (1:ℝ) else 1/(k:ℝ)^2)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0053 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement:
(∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → ∀ k, ‖f k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f) ∧
(∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 2 f → Summable (fun k => ‖f k‖))
arguments.proof:
constructor
· intro f hf k
  have hs : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH,KdVPlan.weight] using hf
  have hle := hs.le_tsum k (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖f j‖)
  change ‖f k‖ ≤ Real.sqrt _
  simpa [KdVPlan.weight] using (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hle)
· intro f hf
  have hs : Summable (fun k : ℤ => (1+(k:ℝ)^2)^2*‖f k‖^2) := by
    simpa [KdVPlan.MemH,KdVPlan.weight,Real.rpow_two] using hf
  have hp : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2)^2) := by
    have hp0 := yui_aux_0053 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
    apply hp0.of_nonneg_of_le
    · intro k; positivity
    · intro k; by_cases hk : k=0
      · simp [hk]
      · rw [if_neg hk]
        have hk0 : (k:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
        have hpos : 0<(k:ℝ)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hk0
        apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((k:ℝ)^2)]
  apply ((hs.add hp).div_const 2).of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _)
  intro k
  have hpos : 0 < 1+(k:ℝ)^2 := by positivity
  have hsq := sq_nonneg ((1+(k:ℝ)^2)*‖f k‖-1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2))
  have hc : ((1+(k:ℝ)^2)*‖f k‖)*(1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2))=‖f k‖ := by field_simp
  have hinv : (1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2))^2=1/(1+(k:ℝ)^2)^2 := by ring
  nlinarith [hc,hinv]

arguments.statement: ∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.Smooth f → ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun j : ℤ => |(j:ℝ)|^m*‖f j‖)
arguments.proof:
intro f hf m
have hmult := yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 (m+2) 2 1 (fun j : ℤ => (j:ℂ)^m) f (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hf (m+2)) ?_
· have h := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 _ hmult.1
  convert h using 1
  funext j
  simp [norm_mul,norm_pow,Complex.norm_intCast]
· intro j
  have hbase : 0 ≤ 1+(j:ℝ)^2 := by positivity
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg (j:ℝ)) (by linarith : (j:ℝ)^2 ≤ 1+(j:ℝ)^2) m
  have hnorm : ‖(j:ℂ)^m‖^2 = ((j:ℝ)^2)^m := by
    simp [norm_pow,Complex.norm_intCast,← pow_mul,abs_pow]
  rw [hnorm]
  simp only [KdVPlan.weight,Real.rpow_two]
  have hexp : (m:ℝ)+2=((m+2:ℕ):ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [hexp,Real.rpow_natCast]
  norm_num only [one_pow,one_mul]
  calc
    (1+(j:ℝ)^2)^2*((j:ℝ)^2)^m ≤ (1+(j:ℝ)^2)^2*(1+(j:ℝ)^2)^m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (1+(j:ℝ)^2)^(m+2) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

arguments.statement: ∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.Smooth f → ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun j : ℤ => |(j:ℝ)|^m*‖f j‖)
arguments.proof:
intro f hf m
have hmult := yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 (m+2) 2 1 (fun j : ℤ => (j:ℂ)^m) f (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hf (m+2)) ?_
· have h := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 _ hmult.1
  convert h using 1
  funext j
  simp [norm_mul,norm_pow,Complex.norm_intCast]
· intro j
  have hbase : 0 ≤ 1+(j:ℝ)^2 := by positivity
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg (j:ℝ)) (by linarith : (j:ℝ)^2 ≤ 1+(j:ℝ)^2) m
  have hnorm := yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 j m
  rw [hnorm]
  simp only [KdVPlan.weight,Real.rpow_two]
  have hexp : (m:ℝ)+2=((m+2:ℕ):ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [hexp,Real.rpow_natCast]

checked : ∀ (T gamma R : ℝ),
  0 < gamma ∧ gamma ≤ 1 →
    KdVPlan.RemOutput →
      KdVPlan.BilinearOutput →
        KdVPlan.ContinuousOutput gamma →
          KdVPlan.SobolevInfrastructure →
            ∀ (t : ℝ) (k j : ℤ),
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(-t * ↑k ^ 3)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(t * ↑j ^ 3)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(t * ↑(k - j) ^ 3)) =
                KdVPlan.phase (3 * ↑k * ↑j * ↑(k - j)) t
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

helper.name: yui_aux_0057
helper.statement:
∀ (t : ℝ) (k j : ℤ),
Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((-t)*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ):ℂ)) *
Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((t*(j:ℝ)^3:ℝ):ℂ)) *
Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((t*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)^3:ℝ):ℂ)) =
KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t
helper.application: @yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement:
∀ (t : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ),
KdVPlan.B t f g k = Complex.I*(k:ℂ) * ∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*f j*g (k-j) ∧
KdVPlan.J t f g k = if k=0 then 0 else ∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD g (k-j)
arguments.proof:
intro t f g k
have hker : ∀ u v : KdVPlan.Coeff,
  KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t u) (KdVPlan.S t v)) k =
  ∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*u j*v (k-j) := by
  intro u v
  simp only [KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.mul]
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro j
  have he := yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 t k j
  rw [← he]; ring
constructor
· change _ * (Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g) k) = _
  rw [mul_left_comm]
  congr 1
  exact hker f g
· by_cases hk : k=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,hk]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,if_neg hk]
    exact hker (KdVPlan.invD f) (KdVPlan.invD g)

arguments.statement:
(∀ α t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (KdVPlan.phase α) ((-Complex.I*(α:ℂ))*KdVPlan.phase α t) t ∧ ‖KdVPlan.phase α t‖=1) ∧
(∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (j : ℤ), ‖KdVPlan.invD f j‖ ≤ ‖f j‖) ∧
∀ (k j : ℤ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g →
(-Complex.I*(3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ)) * KdVPlan.invD f j * KdVPlan.invD g (k-j) = 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*f j*g (k-j)
arguments.proof:
refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
· intro α t
  constructor
  · have h : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => -Complex.I*((r*α:ℝ):ℂ)) (-Complex.I*(α:ℂ)) t := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const α).ofReal_comp).const_mul (-Complex.I)
    convert h.cexp using 1 <;> simp [KdVPlan.phase,mul_comm]
  · simp [KdVPlan.phase,Complex.norm_exp]
· intro f j
  by_cases hj : j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hj]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hj,norm_mul,norm_inv,Complex.norm_I,one_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ |(j:ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hj
    have hi : |(j:ℝ)|⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ h1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f j)]
· intro k j f g hf hg
  by_cases hj : j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hj,hf]
  by_cases hc : k-j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hc,hg]
  have hjc : (j:ℂ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hcc : ((k-j:ℤ):ℂ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hj,if_neg hc]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

  0 < gamma ∧ gamma ≤ 1 →
    KdVPlan.RemOutput →
      KdVPlan.BilinearOutput →

            ∀ (k j c : ℂ),

helper.statement:
∀ (k j c : ℂ), j≠0 → c≠0 →
(-Complex.I*(3*k*j*c))*(Complex.I*j)⁻¹*(Complex.I*c)⁻¹=3*Complex.I*k
helper.application: @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013

arguments.statement:
(∀ α t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (KdVPlan.phase α) ((-Complex.I*(α:ℂ))*KdVPlan.phase α t) t ∧ ‖KdVPlan.phase α t‖=1) ∧
(∀ (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (j : ℤ), ‖KdVPlan.invD f j‖ ≤ ‖f j‖) ∧
∀ (k j : ℤ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g →
(-Complex.I*(3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ)) * KdVPlan.invD f j * KdVPlan.invD g (k-j) = 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*f j*g (k-j)
arguments.proof:
refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
· intro α t
  constructor
  · have h : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => -Complex.I*((r*α:ℝ):ℂ)) (-Complex.I*(α:ℂ)) t := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const α).ofReal_comp).const_mul (-Complex.I)
    simpa only [KdVPlan.phase] using h.cexp
  · simp [KdVPlan.phase,Complex.norm_exp]
· intro f j
  by_cases hj : j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hj]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hj,norm_mul,norm_inv,Complex.norm_I,one_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ |(j:ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hj
    have hi : |(j:ℝ)|⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ h1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f j)]
· intro k j f g hf hg
  by_cases hj : j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hj,show f 0=0 from hf]
  by_cases hc : k-j=0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD,hc,show g 0=0 from hg]
  have hjc : (j:ℂ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hcc : ((k-j:ℤ):ℂ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hj,if_neg hc]
  have he := yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 (k:ℂ) (j:ℂ) ((k-j:ℤ):ℂ) hjc hcc
  have he' : (-Complex.I*((3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ):ℂ))*(Complex.I*(j:ℂ))⁻¹*(Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹=3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ) := by
    convert he using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  calc
    _ = ((-Complex.I*((3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ):ℂ))*(Complex.I*(j:ℂ))⁻¹*(Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹)*f j*g (k-j) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he']

arguments.statement:
∀ (a b Cg Cd : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (g d : KdVPlan.Path),
KdVPlan.MemH 2 f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b g Cg → KdVPlan.UB 0 a b d Cd →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => g r k) (d t k) t) →
∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) (3*KdVPlan.B t f (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t f (d t) k) t
arguments.proof:
intro a b Cg Cd f g d hf hzf hg hd hzg hder t ht k
have hi := yui_aux_0060 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hkform := yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
by_cases hk : k=0
· subst k
  have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := by
    funext r; simp [(hkform r f (g r) 0).2]
  rw [heq]
  have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 t f (g t)
  simpa [show KdVPlan.B t f (g t) 0=0 from hzB,(hkform t f (d t) 0).2] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0:ℂ))
have hfL := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 f hf
have hgb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖g r c‖≤Cg := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hdb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖d r c‖≤Cd := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g t 0)).trans (hgb t ht 0)
have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (d t 0)).trans (hdb t ht 0)
let v : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j)
let v' : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)+KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)
have hnorm : ‖(3:ℂ)*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)‖=3*|(k:ℝ)| := by simp [norm_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
have hbnd : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → ‖v' j r‖ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)|*Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
  intro j r hr
  have hp := (hi.1 (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r).2
  have hiff := hi.2.1 f j
  have hidd := (hi.2.1 (d r) (k-j)).trans (hdb r hr (k-j))
  dsimp [v']
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)‖+
      ‖KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)|*Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
      simp only [norm_mul,hp,one_mul]
      have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
      rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb r hr (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)|*‖f j‖),
        mul_le_mul hiff hidd (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
have hvder : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → HasDerivAt (v j) (v' j r) r := by
  intro j r hr
  have hgder : HasDerivAt (fun s => KdVPlan.invD (g s) (k-j)) (KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)) r := by
    by_cases hc : k-j=0
    · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_pos hc]
      exact hasDerivAt_const r 0
    · simpa only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hc] using (hder r hr (k-j)).const_mul ((Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹)
  have hv := (((hi.1 _ r).1).mul_const (KdVPlan.invD f j)).mul hgder
  convert hv using 1
  dsimp [v,v']
  have hc := hi.2.2 k j f (g r) hzf (hzg r hr)
  calc
    _ = KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r *
      ((-Complex.I*((3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ):ℂ))*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j))+
      KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j) := by rw [hc]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring
have hsum0 : Summable (fun j => v j t) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cg)
  intro j
  dsimp [v]
  rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖f j‖*Cg := mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (g t) (k-j)).trans (hgb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring
have htSum := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)|*Cg+Cd)) isOpen_Ioo (convex_Ioo a b).isPreconnected hvder hbnd ht hsum0 ht
have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) = (fun r => ∑' j, v j r) := by
  funext r; simpa [v,hk] using (hkform r f (g r) k).2
rw [heq]
convert htSum using 1
rw [(hkform t f (g t) k).1,(hkform t f (d t) k).2,if_neg hk]
have hs1 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*f j*g t (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)|*Cg))
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,mul_one]
  have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
  rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb t ht (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)|*‖f j‖)
  nlinarith
have hs2 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d t) (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cd)
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (d t) (k-j)).trans (hdb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
rw [show (∑' j, v' j t) = _ from hs1.tsum_add hs2]
congr 1
rw [← tsum_mul_left,← tsum_mul_left]
apply tsum_congr; intro j; ring

∀ (a b Cg Cd : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (g d : KdVPlan.Path),
KdVPlan.MemH 2 f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b g Cg → KdVPlan.UB 0 a b d Cd →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => g r k) (d t k) t) →
∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) (3*KdVPlan.B t f (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t f (d t) k) t
arguments.proof:
intro a b Cg Cd f g d hf hzf hg hd hzg hder t ht k
have hi := yui_aux_0060 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hkform := yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
by_cases hk : k=0
· subst k
  have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := by
    funext r; simp [(hkform r f (g r) 0).2]
  rw [heq]
  have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 t f (g t)
  simpa [show KdVPlan.B t f (g t) 0=0 from hzB,(hkform t f (d t) 0).2] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0:ℂ))
have hfL := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 f hf
have hgb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖g r c‖≤Cg := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hdb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖d r c‖≤Cd := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g t 0)).trans (hgb t ht 0)
have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (d t 0)).trans (hdb t ht 0)
let v : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j)
let v' : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)+KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)
have hnorm : ‖(3:ℂ)*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)‖=3*|(k:ℝ)| := by simp [norm_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
have hbnd : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → ‖v' j r‖ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
  intro j r hr
  have hp := (hi.1 (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r).2
  have hiff := hi.2.1 f j
  have hidd := (hi.2.1 (d r) (k-j)).trans (hdb r hr (k-j))
  dsimp [v']
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)‖+
      ‖KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
      simp only [norm_mul,hp,one_mul]
      have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
      rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb r hr (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)| *‖f j‖),
        mul_le_mul hiff hidd (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
have hvder : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → HasDerivAt (v j) (v' j r) r := by
  intro j r hr
  have hgder : HasDerivAt (fun s => KdVPlan.invD (g s) (k-j)) (KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)) r := by
    by_cases hc : k-j=0
    · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_pos hc]
      exact hasDerivAt_const r 0
    · simpa only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hc] using (hder r hr (k-j)).const_mul ((Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹)
  have hv := (((hi.1 _ r).1).mul_const (KdVPlan.invD f j)).mul hgder
  convert hv using 1
  dsimp [v,v']
  have hc := hi.2.2 k j f (g r) hzf (hzg r hr)
  calc
    _ = KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r *
      ((-Complex.I*((3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ):ℂ))*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j))+
      KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j) := by rw [hc]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring
have hsum0 : Summable (fun j => v j t) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cg)
  intro j
  dsimp [v]
  rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖f j‖*Cg := mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (g t) (k-j)).trans (hgb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring
have htSum := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)) isOpen_Ioo (convex_Ioo a b).isPreconnected hvder hbnd ht hsum0 ht
have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) = (fun r => ∑' j, v j r) := by
  funext r; simpa [v,hk] using (hkform r f (g r) k).2
rw [heq]
convert htSum using 1
rw [(hkform t f (g t) k).1,(hkform t f (d t) k).2,if_neg hk]
have hs1 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*f j*g t (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg))
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,mul_one]
  have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
  rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb t ht (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)| *‖f j‖)
  nlinarith
have hs2 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d t) (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cd)
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (d t) (k-j)).trans (hdb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
rw [show (∑' j, v' j t) = _ from hs1.tsum_add hs2]
congr 1
rw [← tsum_mul_left,← tsum_mul_left]
apply tsum_congr; intro j; ring

have hi := yui_aux_0060 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hkform := yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
by_cases hk : k=0
· subst k
  have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := by
    funext r; simp [(hkform r f (g r) 0).2]
  rw [heq]
  have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 t f (g t)
  simpa [show KdVPlan.B t f (g t) 0=0 from hzB,(hkform t f (d t) 0).2] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0:ℂ))
have hfL := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 f hf
have hgb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖g r c‖≤Cg := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hdb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖d r c‖≤Cd := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g t 0)).trans (hgb t ht 0)
have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (d t 0)).trans (hdb t ht 0)
let v : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j)
let v' : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)+KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)
have hnorm : ‖(3:ℂ)*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)‖=3*|(k:ℝ)| := by simp [norm_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
have hbnd : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → ‖v' j r‖ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
  intro j r hr
  have hp := (hi.1 (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r).2
  have hiff := hi.2.1 f j
  have hidd := (hi.2.1 (d r) (k-j)).trans (hdb r hr (k-j))
  dsimp [v']
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)‖+

      rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]

    by_cases hc : k-j=0

    · simpa only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hc] using (hder r hr (k-j)).const_mul ((Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹)

  apply hv.congr_deriv

  symm
  have hc := hi.2.2 k j f (g r) hzf (hzg r hr)
  calc

    _ = _ := by ring
have hsum0 : Summable (fun j => v j t) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cg)
  intro j
  dsimp [v]

    _ = _ := by ring

  funext r; simpa [v,hk] using (hkform r f (g r) k).2

apply htSum.congr_deriv

rw [(hkform t f (g t) k).1,(hkform t f (d t) k).2,if_neg hk]
have hs1 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*f j*g t (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg))
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,mul_one]
  have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
  rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb t ht (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)| *‖f j‖)
  nlinarith
have hs2 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d t) (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cd)
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (d t) (k-j)).trans (hdb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
rw [show (∑' j, v' j t) = _ from hs1.tsum_add hs2]
congr 1
rw [← tsum_mul_left,← tsum_mul_left]
apply tsum_congr; intro j; ring

∀ (t : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (z : ℂ),
KdVPlan.J t f (KdVPlan.scale z g)=KdVPlan.scale z (KdVPlan.J t f g) ∧ KdVPlan.J t f 0=0
arguments.proof:
intro t f g z
constructor
· funext k
  rw [(yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 t f (KdVPlan.scale z g) k).2]
  by_cases hk : k=0
  · simp [hk,KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,KdVPlan.scale]
  rw [if_neg hk]
  change _ = z*KdVPlan.J t f g k
  rw [(yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 t f g k).2,if_neg hk,← tsum_mul_left]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro j
  by_cases hj : k-j=0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD,KdVPlan.scale,hj] <;> ring
· funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,KdVPlan.mul,KdVPlan.invD]

arguments.statement:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), a≤b → KdVPlan.Smooth f → KdVPlan.Smooth w → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean w →
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) =
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => f-w) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => f-w) (fun _ => f)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w) (fun _ => f-w)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w)
arguments.proof:
intro a b f w hab hsf hsw hzf hzw
have hnorm := yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hdS : KdVPlan.Smooth (f-w) := fun m => (hnorm.1 m f w (hsf m) (hsw m)).1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hzf,hzw]; ring
have hpc := yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have htri : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z → KdVPlan.ZeroMean x → KdVPlan.ZeroMean y → KdVPlan.ZeroMean z →
KdVPlan.timeInt a b (fun r => KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z)=KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _=>x) (fun _=>y) (fun _=>z) := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz hzx hzy hzz
  exact h_T005.2.2.2.1 a b _ _ _ hab (hpc a b x hx) (hpc a b y hy) (hpc a b z hz) (fun _ _ => ⟨hzx,hzy,hzz⟩)
have hcont : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z →
KdVPlan.ContH 1 a b (fun r => KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z) := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz
  have hcx := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 1 a b x (by simpa using hx 1)
  have hcy := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 1 a b y (by simpa using hy 1)
  have hcz := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 a b z (by simpa using hz 0)
  exact (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 a b _ _ ((yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1 a b _ _ hcx hcy) hcz
have hmB : ∀ r x y, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.B r x y) := by
  rcases (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2.1 with ⟨C,hC,hB⟩
  exact fun r x y hx hy => (hB r x y (by simpa using hx 1) (by simpa using hy 1)).1
have hf0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 f := by simpa using hsf 0
have hw0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 w := by simpa using hsw 0
have hd0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 (f-w) := by simpa using hdS 0
have hsum : f-w+w=f := sub_add_cancel f w
have hbadd := yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hjadd := yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hpoint : ∀ r, KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r f f) f =
 KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f) f+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)) f+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w)+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w := by
  intro r
  have hB1 : KdVPlan.B r f f=KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f+KdVPlan.B r w f := by
    rw [← (hbadd r (f-w) w f f hd0 hw0 hf0 hf0).1,hsum]
  have hB2 : KdVPlan.B r w f=KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)+KdVPlan.B r w w := by
    rw [← (hbadd r w w (f-w) w hw0 hw0 hd0 hw0).2,hsum]
  rw [hB1,hB2]
  have hbdf := hmB r (f-w) f hdS hsf
  have hbwd := hmB r w (f-w) hsw hdS
  have hbww := hmB r w w hsw hsw
  have hbs := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 _ _ hbwd hbww
  rw [(hjadd r _ _ f f hbdf hbs.1 hf0 hf0).1,(hjadd r _ _ f f hbwd hbww hf0 hf0).1]
  have hlast : KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) f=KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w)+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w := by
    rw [← (hjadd r _ _ (f-w) w hbww hbww hd0 hw0).2,hsum]
  rw [hlast]; abel
rw [← htri f f f hsf hsf hsf hzf hzf hzf,
 ← htri (f-w) f f hdS hsf hsf hzd hzf hzf,
 ← htri w (f-w) f hsw hdS hsf hzw hzd hzf,
 ← htri w w (f-w) hsw hsw hdS hzw hzw hzd,
 ← htri w w w hsw hsw hsw hzw hzw hzw]
funext k
change (∫ r in a..b, KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r f f) f k) = _
have hint : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z →
IntervalIntegrable (fun r=>KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z k) volume a b := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz
  exact yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a b _ hab (yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 1 a b _ (hcont x y z hx hy hz) k)
have h1 := hint (f-w) f f hdS hsf hsf
have h2 := hint w (f-w) f hsw hdS hsf
have h3 := hint w w (f-w) hsw hsw hdS
have h4 := hint w w w hsw hsw hsw
calc
 _ = ∫ r in a..b, (KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f) f k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)) f k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w) k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w k) := by
   apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr; intro r _; exact congrFun (hpoint r) k
 _ = _ := by
   rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((h1.add h2).add h3) h4,intervalIntegral.integral_add (h1.add h2) h3,intervalIntegral.integral_add h1 h2]
   rfl

rcases h_T006.1.2.1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) with ⟨C0,hC0,htr0⟩
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 gamma h_H002.1.le h_H002.2 with ⟨Cg,hCg,htrg⟩
let C := 3*C0*(M+1)^2+Cg*(M+1)^3
refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs t ht
have hsmall := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 M a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hf,hw,hsf,hsw,hwM,hd1⟩
have hw0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw.1
have hwbound : KdVPlan.hn 0 w≤M+1 := by linarith [hw0.2]
have hfn := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2
have hdmem := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 f w hf.1 hw0.1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hf.2.1,hw.2.1]; ring
have htlen : t-a≤1 := by linarith [ht.2]
have h1 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen (f-w) f f hdmem.1 hf.1 hf.1 hzd hf.2.1 hf.2.1
have h2 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w (f-w) f hw0.1 hdmem.1 hf.1 hw.2.1 hzd hf.2.1
have h3 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w w (f-w) hw0.1 hw0.1 hdmem.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hzd
have h4 := htrg a t ha ht.1 htlen w w w hw.1 hw.1 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1
simp only [Real.rpow_zero,mul_one] at h1 h2 h3
have hsum := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hs12 := hsum 0 _ _ h1.1 h2.1
have hs123 := hsum 0 _ _ hs12.1 h3.1
have hsall := hsum 0 _ _ hs123.1 h4.1
rw [yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f w ht.1 hsf hsw hf.2.1 hw.2.1]
refine ⟨hsall.1,?_⟩
have hp : (t-a)^gamma ≤ τ^gamma := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) h_H002.1.le
have hu1 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hsmall.1; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu2 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu3 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hwbound
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu4 : Cg*(t-a)^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ Cg*(M+1)^3*τ^gamma := by
  calc
    _ ≤ Cg*τ^gamma*(M+1)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hδq : KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma)
have hpq : τ^gamma≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hfn 0 (f-w))
dsimp [C]
have hA : 0≤3*C0*(M+1)^2 := by positivity
have hB : 0≤Cg*(M+1)^3 := by positivity

 mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδq hA,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq hB]

arguments.proof:
intro M hM
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) with ⟨C0,hC0,htr0⟩
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 gamma h_H002.1.le h_H002.2 with ⟨Cg,hCg,htrg⟩
let C := 3*C0*(M+1)^2+Cg*(M+1)^3
refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs t ht
have hsmall := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 M a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hf,hw,hsf,hsw,hwM,hd1⟩
have hw0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw.1
have hwbound : KdVPlan.hn 0 w≤M+1 := by linarith [hw0.2]
have hfn := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2
have hnF := hfn 0 f
have hnW := hfn 0 w
have hnD := hfn 0 (f-w)
have hnG := hfn gamma w
have hdmem := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 f w hf.1 hw0.1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hf.2.1,hw.2.1]; ring
have htlen : t-a≤1 := by linarith [ht.2]
have h1 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen (f-w) f f hdmem.1 hf.1 hf.1 hzd hf.2.1 hf.2.1
have h2 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w (f-w) f hw0.1 hdmem.1 hf.1 hw.2.1 hzd hf.2.1
have h3 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w w (f-w) hw0.1 hw0.1 hdmem.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hzd
have h4 := htrg a t ha ht.1 htlen w w w hw.1 hw.1 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1
simp only [Real.rpow_zero,mul_one] at h1 h2 h3
have hsum := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hs12 := hsum 0 _ _ h1.1 h2.1
have hs123 := hsum 0 _ _ hs12.1 h3.1
have hsall := hsum 0 _ _ hs123.1 h4.1
rw [yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f w ht.1 hsf hsw hf.2.1 hw.2.1]
refine ⟨hsall.1,?_⟩
have hp : (t-a)^gamma ≤ τ^gamma := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) h_H002.1.le
have hu1 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hsmall.1; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu2 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu3 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hwbound
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu4 : Cg*(t-a)^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ Cg*(M+1)^3*τ^gamma := by
  calc
    _ ≤ Cg*τ^gamma*(M+1)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hδq : KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma)
have hpq : τ^gamma≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hfn 0 (f-w))
dsimp [C]
have hA : 0≤3*C0*(M+1)^2 := by positivity
have hB : 0≤Cg*(M+1)^3 := by positivity
nlinarith [h1.2,h2.2,h3.2,h4.2,hs12.2,hs123.2,hsall.2,
 mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδq hA,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq hB]

∀ M : ℝ, 1≤M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (a τ : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.StepData gamma M a τ f w →
∀ t∈Icc a (a+τ), KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a t (fun _=>f) (fun _=>f) (fun _=>f)) (C*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)
arguments.proof:
intro M hM
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) with ⟨C0,hC0,htr0⟩
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 gamma h_H002.1.le h_H002.2 with ⟨Cg,hCg,htrg⟩
let C := 3*C0*(M+1)^2+Cg*(M+1)^3
refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs t ht
have hsmall := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 M a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hf,hw,hsf,hsw,hwM,hd1⟩
have hw0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw.1
have hwbound : KdVPlan.hn 0 w≤M+1 := by linarith [hw0.2]
have hfn := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2
have hnF := hfn 0 f
have hnW := hfn 0 w
have hnD := hfn 0 (f-w)
have hnG := hfn gamma w
have hdmem := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 f w hf.1 hw0.1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hf.2.1,hw.2.1]; ring
have htlen : t-a≤1 := by linarith [ht.2]
have h1 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen (f-w) f f hdmem.1 hf.1 hf.1 hzd hf.2.1 hf.2.1
have h2 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w (f-w) f hw0.1 hdmem.1 hf.1 hw.2.1 hzd hf.2.1
have h3 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w w (f-w) hw0.1 hw0.1 hdmem.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hzd
have h4 := htrg a t ha ht.1 htlen w w w hw.1 hw.1 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1
simp only [Real.rpow_zero,mul_one] at h1 h2 h3
have hsum := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hs12 := hsum 0 _ _ h1.1 h2.1
have hs123 := hsum 0 _ _ hs12.1 h3.1
have hsall := hsum 0 _ _ hs123.1 h4.1
rw [yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f w ht.1 hsf hsw hf.2.1 hw.2.1]
refine ⟨hsall.1,?_⟩
have hp : (t-a)^gamma ≤ τ^gamma := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) h_H002.1.le
have hu1 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu2 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu3 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu4 : Cg*(t-a)^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ Cg*(M+1)^3*τ^gamma := by
  calc
    _ ≤ Cg*τ^gamma*(M+1)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hδq : KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma)
have hpq : τ^gamma≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hfn 0 (f-w))
dsimp [C]
have hA : 0≤3*C0*(M+1)^2 := by positivity
have hB : 0≤Cg*(M+1)^3 := by positivity
nlinarith [h1.2,h2.2,h3.2,h4.2,hs12.2,hs123.2,hsall.2,
 mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδq hA,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq hB]

(∀ (u v : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.invD (u+v)=KdVPlan.invD u+KdVPlan.invD v ∧ KdVPlan.invD (u-v)=KdVPlan.invD u-KdVPlan.invD v) ∧
(∀ (z : ℂ) (u : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.scale z u)=KdVPlan.scale z (KdVPlan.invD u)) ∧
∀ (a b : ℝ) (u d : KdVPlan.Path), (∀ t∈Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r=>u r k) (d t k) t) →

arguments.proof:
refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
· intro u v
  constructor <;> funext k <;> by_cases hk : k=0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD,hk,mul_add,mul_sub]
· intro z u
  funext k; by_cases hk : k=0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD,KdVPlan.scale,hk] <;> ring
· intro a b u d h t ht k
  by_cases hk : k=0
  · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_pos hk]; exact hasDerivAt_const t 0
  · simpa only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hk] using (h t ht k).const_mul ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹)

arguments.statement:
∀ (s a b C : ℝ) (u d : KdVPlan.Path), a≤b → 0≤C →
KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → KdVPlan.ContH s a b d → KdVPlan.UB s a b d C → u a=0 →
(∀ t∈Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r=>u r k) (d t k) t) →

arguments.proof:
intro s a b C u d hab hC hu hd hdb hua hder
have hp := yui_aux_0027 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b C d hab hd hdb
intro t ht
have heq : KdVPlan.timeInt a t d=u t := by
  funext k
  have hcu := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b u hu k
  have hcd := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b d hd k
  have hsub : Icc a t ⊆ Icc a b := Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2
  have hi := yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t _ ht.1 (hcd.mono hsub)
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le ht.1 (hcu.mono hsub)
    (fun r hr => hder r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩ k) hi
  change (∫ r in a..t, d r k)=u t k
  simpa [hua] using h
have hb := hp.2 t ht
rw [heq] at hb
exact ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [ht.2]) hC)⟩

intro M hM
rcases yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cb,hCb,hb⟩

rcases yui_aux_0050 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cw,hCw,hw⟩
rcases yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cy,hCy,hy⟩
let Cd := Cb+Cf+Cw
refine ⟨Cy+Cd,by dsimp [Cd]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs
have hBI := hb a τ f w hs
have hFF := hf a τ f w hs
have hWW := hw a τ f w hs
have hYY := hy a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hfd,hwd,hfs,hws,hwM,hd1⟩
have hab : a≤a+τ := by linarith
have hq : 0≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma) ((yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (f-w))

have hW := hWW a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩
have hWbound : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) (Cw*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hW.2.1,?_⟩
  linarith [hW.2.2,(yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (KdVPlan.Qst a f a)]
have h52 := yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f hτ (by simpa using hfs 1) hfd.2.1 hW.2.1
let D : KdVPlan.Path := fun t=>KdVPlan.B t f (KdVPlan.F a f t)+KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t))-KdVPlan.scale ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)
have hDc : KdVPlan.ContH 0 a (a+τ) D := h52.2.1
have hId := yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hA := yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hInv := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1
have hNormInv : ‖(τ:ℂ)⁻¹‖=τ⁻¹ := by simp [norm_inv,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hτ]

  rw [he] at hinv
  have hh := (hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ ((hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ hB hhalf).1) hinv).2
  have heq : KdVPlan.invD (D t)=KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.B t f (KdVPlan.F a f t))+KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t)))-KdVPlan.scale ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)) := by

  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨hh.1,by dsimp [Cd]; nlinarith [hh.2,mul_nonneg hCf.le hq]⟩

have hIcD1 := (yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 a (a+τ) D hDc
have hIcY := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 1 a (a+τ) _ (by norm_num) hIcY1
have hIcD := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 1 a (a+τ) _ (by norm_num) hIcD1
have hYzero := (yui_aux_0051 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f).2.2.2
have hIYzero : KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f a)=0 := by rw [hYzero]; funext k; simp [KdVPlan.invD]
have hIYder := hId.2.2 a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) D h52.2.2.1
have hIY := yui_aux_0072 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 0 a (a+τ) (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) _ _ hab (mul_nonneg hCd.le hq) hIcY hIcD hInvDb hIYzero hIYder
have hIY' : KdVPlan.UB 0 a (a+τ) (fun t=>KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t)) (Cd*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using hIY
rcases h_T005.1.1 with ⟨C,hC,hBasic⟩

KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) A (KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)) := by
  intro A hz hm

have hzD : ∀ t, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (D t) := by
  intro t

have hDb : KdVPlan.UB (-KdVPlan.pstar) a (a+τ) D (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  intro t ht
  have h := hneg (D t) (hzD t) (hInvDb t ht).1
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.trans (hInvDb t ht).2⟩
have hnegY : KdVPlan.UB (-KdVPlan.pstar) a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (Cd*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  intro t ht

· intro t ht
  exact ⟨(hIY' t ht).1,(hIY' t ht).2.trans (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCy.le hτ.le) hq])⟩
· filter_upwards [hX.1,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t he ht
